text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟和亚郎说：

text_en: The Israelites shall camp each in their respective regiments, under ensigns by their ancestral houses; they shall camp facing the tent of meeting on every side.
text_cn: “以色列子民每人应随自己的旗帜，在自己宗族的标志下扎营，都向着会幕，在四周稍远的地方扎营。

text_en: Those to camp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the regimental encampment of Judah by companies. The leader of the people of Judah shall be Nahshon son of Amminadab,
text_cn: 在前面，即东方，是犹大军团扎营的旗帜：犹大子孙的首领是阿米纳达布的儿子纳赫雄；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of seventy-four thousand six hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是七万四千六百。

text_en: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The leader of the Issacharites shall be Nethanel son of Zuar,
text_cn: 在其傍扎营的是依撒加尔支派；依撒加尔子孙的首领是族阿尔的儿子乃塔乃耳；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of fifty-four thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是五万四千四百。

text_en: Then the tribe of Zebulun: The leader of the Zebulunites shall be Eliab son of Helon,
text_cn: 随后是则步隆支派；则步隆子孙的首领是赫隆的儿子厄里雅布；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是五万七千四百。

text_en: The total enrollment of the camp of Judah, by companies, is one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred. They shall set out first on the march.
text_cn: 犹大军团登记的，共计十八万六千四百；他们应首先出发。

text_en: On the south side shall be the regimental encampment of Reuben by companies. The leader of the Reubenites shall be Elizur son of Shedeur,
text_cn: 南方是勒乌本军团扎营的旗帜：勒乌本子孙的首领是舍德乌尔的儿子厄里族尔；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of forty-six thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是四万六千五百。

text_en: And those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The leader of the Simeonites shall be Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
text_cn: 在其傍扎营的，是西默盎支派；西默盎子孙的首领是族黎沙待的儿子舍路米耳；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是五万九千三百。

text_en: Then the tribe of Gad: The leader of the Gadites shall be Eliasaph son of Reuel,
text_cn: 随后是加得支派；加得子孙的首领是勒乌耳的儿子厄肋雅撒夫；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是四万五千六百五十。

text_en: The total enrollment of the camp of Reuben, by companies, is one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty. They shall set out second.
text_cn: 勒乌本军团登记的，共计十五万一千四百五十；他们其次出发。

text_en: The tent of meeting, with the camp of the Levites, shall set out in the center of the camps; they shall set out just as they camp, each in position, by their regiments.
text_cn: 随后，会幕与肋未营在各营中心启程前行；各营怎样扎营，就怎样出发前行，各依自己的位置，各随自己的旗帜。

text_en: On the west side shall be the regimental encampment of Ephraim by companies. The leader of the people of Ephraim shall be Elishama son of Ammihud,
text_cn: 西方是厄弗辣因军团扎营的旗帜：厄弗辣因子孙的首领是阿米胡得的儿子厄里沙玛；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of forty thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是四万五百。

text_en: Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The leader of the people of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
text_cn: 在其傍是默纳协支派；默纳协子孙的首领是培达族尔的儿子加默里耳；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of thirty-two thousand two hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是三万二千二百。

text_en: Then the tribe of Benjamin: The leader of the Benjaminites shall be Abidan son of Gideoni,
text_cn: 随后是本雅明支派；本雅明子孙的首领是基德敖尼的儿子阿彼丹；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of thirty-five thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是三万五千四百。

text_en: The total enrollment of the camp of Ephraim, by companies, is one hundred eight thousand one hundred. They shall set out third on the march.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因军团登记的，共计十万八千一百；他们作第三队出发。

text_en: On the north side shall be the regimental encampment of Dan by companies. The leader of the Danites shall be Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,
text_cn: 北方是丹军团扎营的旗帜：丹子孙的首领是阿米沙待的儿子阿希厄则尔；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是六万二千七百。

text_en: Those to camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The leader of the Asherites shall be Pagiel son of Ochran,
text_cn: 在其傍扎营的是阿协尔支派；阿协尔子孙的首领是敖革兰的儿子帕革厄耳；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of forty-one thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是四万一千五百。

text_en: Then the tribe of Naphtali: The leader of the Naphtalites shall be Ahira son of Enan,
text_cn: 随后是纳斐塔里支派；纳斐塔里子孙的首领是厄南的儿子阿希辣；

text_en: with a company as enrolled of fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 他的部队登记的，是五万三千四百。

text_en: The total enrollment of the camp of Dan is one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last, by companies.
text_cn: 丹军团登记的，共计十五万七千六百；他们随着自己的旗帜，最后出发。”

text_en: This was the enrollment of the Israelites by their ancestral houses; the total enrollment in the camps by their companies was six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
text_cn: 这就是以色列子民依照家系登记的数目；各营的部队登记的总数，共六十万三千五百五十。

text_en: Just as the Lord had commanded Moses, the Levites were not enrolled among the other Israelites.
text_cn: 照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的，肋未人没有在以色列子民中登记。

text_en: The Israelites did just as the Lord had commanded Moses: They camped by regiments, and they set out the same way, everyone by clans, according to ancestral houses.
text_cn: 以色列子民全照上主吩咐梅瑟的做了，都随着自己的旗帜扎营，各随宗族和家系出发进行。
